basic_info.description: Experience quintessential San Francisco living at 880 Chestnut Street, perched atop Russian Hill with sweeping Bay views and timeless charm. This light-filled home features a spacious layout with generous living and dining areas, a cozy gas fireplace, and large windows framing stunning outlooks. The thoughtfully designed kitchen offers ample storage and modern updates, while the comfortable bedrooms and well-appointed bath provide privacy and ease. Unique highlights include a deeded roof deck with Bay views, perfect for entertaining or relaxing, and access to a shared landscaped yard. Additional conveniences include assigned parking and laundry in unit. Just moments from Hyde Street's cable cars, world-class dining, charming cafes, and scenic parks, this residence blends location, comfort, and iconic San Francisco style.
